title: Not Well Made
text: Not Well Made. One of the chopping grids broke the very first time we used it (while cutting squash). An entire metal strip came off into the squash! Definitely poorly made. I could talk about capacity, slicing, washing, and storage— but why bother? If the chopping grids fall apart into the food— none of the rest of the features matter.
